summary: Verizon Communications filed an 8-K reporting routine disclosure of its outstanding debt securities and common stock listings. The filing lists numerous notes due from 2026 to 2056 along with its common stock traded on NYSE and Nasdaq. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is described. This is a standard current report providing updated information on securities registered under Section 12(b) of the Exchange Act. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. Nothing further to analyze.
